DASHBOARD.TITLE: Manage your favorite movies and TV shows
DASHBOARD.DESCRIPTION: Movie Keeper is your personal space to organize what you watch. Create custom lists — watchlists, favorites, top 10, picks — and explore TMDB data enriched with JustWatch availability.
DASHBOARD.MOVIE_DESC: Find the ranking of the most watched and top-rated movies by the community, along with availability on Netflix, Prime Video, Canal+, and all streaming platforms.
DASHBOARD.TV_DESC: From the latest seasons to classics to catch up on, discover the top 10 TV shows praised by film lovers and track their streaming availability.
DASHBOARD.ARTIST_DESC: Actors, directors, screenwriters — explore the most followed personalities in the film industry and find their complete filmography in one click.
DASHBOARD.CINEPHILIE_DESC: Whether you love blockbusters, indie films, or genre TV shows, Movie Keeper lets you track what you've watched, what's left to discover, and share your favorites with your loved ones.
DASHBOARD.MOVIE_TO_SEE_DESC: Build your watchlist and never miss a movie recommended by your friends again.
DASHBOARD.TOP_PERSO_DESC: Create your own ranking and keep track of your all-time favorite movies.
DASHBOARD.STREAMING_TITLE_DESC: Instantly know which platform to use to watch the movie you've picked.
